method.primary_outcome: baseline-adjusted log1p endpoint volume model; BH across 15 pairwise comparisons
method.secondary_outcome: absolute tumor volume change (mm^3); exact two-arm permutations and raw-scale interaction sensitivity
method.experimental_unit: animal position within a treatment block, as implied by source workbook layout
method.pairwise: enumerated two-sided label permutation for combination vs vehicle and each monotherapy; all assignments for each 6-vs-6 comparison
method.multiplicity: BH across 15 primary pairwise comparisons (3 per 5 models)
method.factorial_interaction: Welch-Satterthwaite contrast with t-based 95% CI on raw change scale; approximate under small n
method.important: animal identifiers are not supplied; within-animal identity across repeated time points assumed from column position; this is a reanalysis of the same publication, not independent replication
